content: Detecting hardcoded untranslated strings in an existing JS codebase: standard practice is a custom ESLint rule flagging literal strings inside JSX/template literals and UI attributes (e.g. no-hardcoded-ui-string), run in warn mode to measure blast radius before flipping to error; plus catalogue-completeness checks (same key sets across locales, matching placeholder sets) and rendered-DOM leak detection using a forbidden-word list derived from the source catalogue rather than hand-written. Reference patterns: eslint-plugin-local-rules / RuleTester, i18next-cli eslint plugin, formatjs/cli ICU validation.
